chapter: Lost in a Foreign Land: Seeking
act_title: Lost in a Foreign Land: Seeking

quests.title: Lost in a Foreign Land: Seeking

dialogue.t: I need to get some rest now. My old injuries still hurt. My apologies.
Please come back another day if you have more questions. I'll also have a favor to ask.
"...I made it into this secret chamber. The mechanical monster is still lurking outside like a ferocious predator, just waiting for me to go out..."
"...My left leg is badly wounded and it hurts like hell. I bandaged it up haphazardly, but it's swollen — could be a sign of infection..."
"...The grotto has another exit, but I don't know where it leads. The structure of the exit looks tenuous. Without something to support it, it might collapse if exposed to violent force..."
"...I've been spotted! Someone's coming. It's a... swordsman... clad in black?"
"...He, no, it... Seems as though even metal bars are no obstacle for it. And just from looking upon it, I know this in my heart..."
"...I'm sorry, Katya."
Ah, you came! Sit and make yourself at home.
I'm sorry that I sent you away in a hurry last time. I didn't even tell you what I wanted you to help me with.

dialogue.sit: It's fine. You can say it now.
No worries. We haven't yet said yes.

dialogue.t: Relax, I won't make you do anything evil.

dialogue.sit: You certainly won't let us interfere with the Fatui's plans.

dialogue.t: Well, I have been separated from my Kolya — Nikolay, a member of my team.
Could you help me look for him?
If he's still alive, bring him back to me. If he's dead... please let me know.
I'm sorry to lay this on you... But please consider my request.
So, this is what you want us to do? Paimon thought you were up to something bad like, say, asking us to sabotage the Millelith's work...
The Millelith... why? It does no good to make them our enemy.
That's my line!
Hang on, I got it... Did our people on the surface get into an altercation with the people of Liyue? That would certainly explain why our supplies have been cut off.
Darn it! What on earth happened up there...
Hmph... Let's leave this topic for another day. War is war — there are no eternal allies nor perpetual enemies. That's the reality that we, the Fatui, live in.
But I — at least for now — care about nothing but Kolya.
When we retreated, he was separated from the squad... I came back for him later and got lost myself, too. *sigh* What a shame...
As for where he was before he went missing, I can mark it out on the map for you.
At the time, he tried to lure the enemies chasing us away from the rest of the team... He's an excellent soldier, and I know for sure that he wouldn't die there.
I can only hope that he has left us some clues...
"... Oh no! Katya's balalaika is broken. I somehow damaged it during the fracas. Gotta get it repaired before she chews me out..."
"...Did our ancestors fight the calamity like this five hundred years ago? The Kapitan-Poruchik once said we knew not a hundredth of the grueling battles that our ancestors went through..."
(Many pages in the middle are tainted by some black substance. When you clean it off, the writing in ink is also rendered entirely illegible.)
"...I can't stay here any longer. They could easily track me down through the black mud..."
"...Next, I'm gonna go the opposite direction and lure them further away from the rest of the squad..."
"...There's a hole near the ruined bastion on the southeast side. Maybe I can take that route..."
"...Wish me luck. If not us, then who?"
You're back. Did you find anything?
It's alright if you found nothing. Go get some rest.
Don't you worry about me... I'm not anxious. After all, I kinda wanna stay here for my retirement. Maybe I'll ask you to deal with my pension application!
Wow, you sure are getting some good rest!
Hmph, if you keep coming back here without bringing me any news... Who knows, you might just find me resting till I rest in peace.
Eh... Is this the insignia left behind by the Fatui guy?
Uh... There's no sign of anyone. What are we supposed to tell Katya?
Well, Paimon guesses there's not much we can do. Let's head back.
You're back. I have some Fire-Water to spare.
Haha, I'm not inviting you to drink. It can also be used to clean your wounds if you're injured.
How is it? Did you find anything?
These are... insignias, action logs, and... note?
Please tell me where Kolya is. Is he still alive?

dialogue.sit: We didn't find him, but he's probably still alive.
He might've escaped through a secret tunnel.

dialogue.t: Kolya would never desert and abandon me. I'm sure of it, I just know it. He wouldn't run away in the face of a battle.
Where did you find these?

dialogue.sit: A cave in the southeast. Let me mark it out for you.

dialogue.t: It's a creepy place with many monsters inside it.
Th—Thank you... I'm sorry...
I... I hope Kolya sold his life dearly. I'd rather that's what happened.
Kolya, please don't bring shame to the Tsaritsa. Don't bring shame on me.
Ahem, I—I'm fine... Just got a bit sentimental there. It just occurred to me that I haven't properly thanked you two!
Oh right, here's some Fire-Water... *sigh* But you don't drink, do you?
I have some Mora...and some other materials that I collected. They are of no use to me now, so please take them.
What's my plan next? Thank you for asking, but I don't need you to assist me in my "evil-doing" anymore.
Well, I'll go looking for Kolya, perhaps.
He wrote me a letter before I was redeployed, which I have with me. For me, it's the only evidence left that proves his existence, and I'll carry it with me, forever.
If he's still alive... As a Fatuus loyal to the Tsaritsa, I'll hunt this traitor down and kill him, wherever he goes or hides.
If he is no longer in this world... As his older sister, I will embrace the inevitable fate of every Fatuus and will be proud of him.
When we say "if not us, then who"... Well, this is what that means.

dialogue.sit: What if you're up to something evil and I must stop you?
Do you always have to do it the Fatui way?

dialogue.t: ...There's always a moment when you're left with no choice. And we all have things that we must do, right?
You're too serious. I mean, I get it. Kids who haven't grown old enough to hold their liquor tend to get drowned in all sorts of strange worries.
I mean, we'll see, won't we? Let's see what I'll do when I need to face the final, inevitable choice.
But for now, what I need is to take a nap... Wanna rest too?
There's only a straw mat here. That doesn't make a comfy bed! You're just trying to get rid of us!
Well, I don't see how that's my problem! Ah, I pity you...
But anyway, thank you for your help.

quests.description: You run into a Fatui mage named Katarina who is wandering alone in The Chasm. What is she doing here? Ask her what’s going on.
